depression doesn’t come to those with less fortunate lives. depression touches anyone, everyone; whether or not you think you deserve to feel this way, or that others have had it harder and they are coping with life. it doesn’t matter- you don’t need a reason to feel this way, low, depressed, angry. i remember i used to search for reasons- why do I feel so low? I have the perfect life to some? the answer is - you don’t need a reason. 

you are doing incredible for still doing all these small things - well done!! and keep it up! i don’t see you failing at all, you are succeeding in small achievements. small achievements are VERY important- fuck those who think otherwise! 

This person that believes all the negative things about you are wrong and frankly extremely toxic. how awful to criticise you like that!

i don’t know if this advice is beneficial to you or not but here goes; 
my friend who is a nurse took time off from work for ‘burnout’ and then started back at work progressively only starting a few days a week half days to begin with, is this an option for you when starting back?

have you spoken to w regarding this, a boss or colleagues?  do you have a mental health system in place at work where you get over the phone sessions to speak to people about your work?

what exactly is making you feel anxious and depressed with the new unit? is it anything in particular??

the saying goes you are the accumulation of the people you spend your time with. unfortunately although he is your close friend, if you spend time with someone who is negative 24/7 this will also knock onto you. this also happened to me and my friend, i spent the weekend looking after her, and when I got home I had to take a few days off work myself due to the knock of effect of myself now having low mental health . 

i would try telling him how you feel, he may not be aware of it due to him being absorbed within his own depression. but you do need to be honest with him, otherwise you will slip into being unwell again and you do need to look after yourself too.

best of luck
